title: Stored hydrogen carried from Node Beta to Nova Terra Central and sold into its bid at 35 cr or more
note: 2026-11-21 23:50 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-059 block MERCURY: buyers further out; rule F24, surplus). No home station bids for hydrogen since the pause (books of 23:4x UTC); 11,177 hydrogen lie in our storages beyond the reserve, 6,648 at Node Beta (sellgen.py scan, skill trade-books). Nova Terra Central (8 jumps, 3 lawless) bids 38 x 99 (book of 23:42 UTC), the nearest bid. About 2,400 cr a Threshold load of 65 against about 16 jumps of fuel. requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage at Node Beta holds 65 hydrogen; requires.bid closes the route while Nova Terra's book shows the bid under 35 or under 40 units. Nothing is bought. Open to every division's ships: each sells its own stores. A test: one ship.
